info.title: Trading Dashboard API
info.description: Native Nest request DTOs and validated JSON wire responses. Unknown DTO keys are rejected. Query numbers are serialized as strings; empty numeric values are rejected except the documented fills limit fallback. Conditional business constraints (settings revisions, rule parameters and import column semantics) are described on their inputs. Privy bearer tokens identify users; server-owned roles and permissions authorize access. Public favorites queries require a human user. Service tokens cannot act as an owned profile.

bearerAuth.description: Privy access token, or scoped service token where permitted.

expectedMandateRevision.description: Observed revision of the original approved mandate

consentSignature.description: Main-wallet EIP-712 signature over the exact cancellation intent

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for this exact return

amount.description: Exact positive testnet USDC, at most six decimals, or "all" once the copy is stopped and flat

consentSignature.description: Main-wallet EIP-712 signature over the exact consent

coin.description: The position's market, as the account snapshot names it

idempotencyKey.description: Keep the same key until the original claim is resolved

color.description: Chip colour; assigned in turn when omitted

message.description: Shown to visitors; empty strings show the web's own wording

endsAt.description: Expected end, shown to visitors. Informational: writes stay refused until maintenance is switched off

maxFavoritesPerUser.description: Favorites a user may keep; null uses the deployment's MAX_FAVORITES_PER_USER

maxWatchedAddresses.description: Addresses watched for users' favorites and copies, across all users

maintenance.description: The whole value when changed: enabled, message and endsAt

expectedRevisions.description: Required for every changed settings section (428 if missing; 409 if stale). Read the revisions from GET /admin/settings.

role.description: operator = read-only operations: every *.read grant, no write

paramsJson.description: For R1/R3, flatThresholdUsd and pctThreshold must both be finite positive numbers. Other rule-specific semantics are checked by the service.

rows.description: Dynamic column maps; address, ranking and tier semantics are checked by the import service.

avatarUrl.description: https URL; omit to derive from the 𝕏 handle

csv.description: CSV with a header row: address, display_name, x_handle, verified, sort_order[, avatar_url]

replace.description: Remove KOLs the file doesn't list (only when every row is valid)

amount.description: Exact USDC amount, more than $1, at most six decimals
Exact USDC amount, more than $1, at most six decimals

nonce.description: Original nonce; never creates a new withdrawal

signature.description: Ephemeral 65-byte EIP-712 signature for this immutable intent

idempotencyKey.description: Stable operation key retained across retries

direction.description: 順向 same / 反向 reverse (CopyDog copy_direction)

allocationUsd.description: Paper USDC moved from the paper balance into this copy (CopyDog allocation_amount); at most 6 decimals

perTradeUsd.description: Fixed mode: USDC notional per copied open

copyStartMode.description: adopt = 跟單目前持倉 on

amountUsd.description: Paper USDC to add (CopyDog 加碼); at most 6 decimals

command.description: pause = pause_new_risk; stop = close_positions, then the copy's cash returns to the paper balance

network.description: Must equal the deployment's wallet network

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for this exact account and amount

amount.description: Exact positive testnet USDC, at most six decimals

signature.description: Ephemeral signature of the immutable usdSend intent

consentSignature.description: Ephemeral signature of the exact main-wallet CopyAgentConsent challenge
Ephemeral main-wallet signature of the exact CopyAccountModeConsent challenge

sourceNetwork.description: Only testnet sources are currently supported

budgetUsd.description: Explicit real-account risk budget; does not allocate funds

consentSignature.description: Ephemeral owner signature of the exact CopyTradingMandate intent

userId.description: Required for scope `user`; not allowed for `platform`

reason.description: Why; kept in the control events and the admin audit log

expectedRevision.description: The scope's revision when the page loaded; 409 stale_revision otherwise

blockedCoins.description: Hyperliquid perp names (BTC, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA); matched case-insensitively and stored in Hyperliquid's spelling

expectedVersion.description: The version the form was loaded with; 409 stale_version otherwise

force.description: Revoke now even while the copy's stop has not ended; positions may remain on the copy account
